**Software Development** – Typical pay $80 k–$120 k+ [8][1]. Bootcamps or self‑study + portfolio can get you a junior role in 1–3 years.  

**Cybersecurity Analyst** – Typical pay $70 k–$110 k+ [8][1]. A 1–2 year path with CompTIA Security+, CEH or similar plus hands‑on labs is common.  

**Cloud Engineer / DevOps** – Typical pay $90 k–$130 k+ [8][1]. 2–4 years of training (AWS, Azure, GCP certs + projects) usually suffices for an entry‑level position.  

**Data Analyst / Data Scientist** – Typical pay $70 k–$120 k+ [8][1]. 1–3 years of bootcamp, SQL, Python/R and a data‑project portfolio typically opens doors.  

**Digital Marketing Manager / SEO Specialist** – Typical pay $60 k–$100 k+ [8][1]. 1–2 years of coursework, certifications (Google Ads, HubSpot, SEMrush) plus a proven campaign track record usually lands a mid‑level role.  

All five categories are highlighted in the 2026 guide on tech roles without a degree [1] and fall within the $70 k–$130 k+ median range cited by the résumé‑style survey [8].

Software developer – **$80 k–$120 k+** typical pay [8][1]. Build a portfolio of coding projects and gain hands‑on experience; most people land a junior role after a few years of focused learning and practice, though the exact timeline varies [1].

Cybersecurity analyst – **$70 k–$110 k+** typical pay [8][1]. Demonstrate security knowledge and hands‑on experience; most entrants secure an analyst position after a few years of study and real‑world work, but the path differs [1].

Cloud engineer / DevOps – **$90 k–$130 k+** typical pay [8][1]. Develop skills in cloud platforms and automation tools; most people break into this area after a few years of learning and project experience, though timelines vary [1].

Data analyst / data scientist – **$70 k–$120 k+** typical pay [8][1]. Master data manipulation, statistical tools, and produce a portfolio of data projects; most professionals enter the field after a few years of focused study and experience, but the exact timeline differs [1].

Network engineer – **$70 k–$130 k+** median salary [8]. Acquire knowledge of networking protocols and hands-on configuration; most people obtain roles in specialized tech fields with relevant certifications and experience.
